scope.parallel_tree_caveat: 工作区仍可能有并行写入；本报告把当前读到的缺口标为待验证或当前阻碍，不把暂时未出现的文件一律断言为最终缺失。对已经存在且显式返回 unsupported/需要宿主的代码，按真实当前覆盖计入缺口。

summary.conclusion: 当前 app 已有可读的 Go parser/builder、runtime/storage、部分 libbox CommandClient 封装、WARP 客户端和 RyUI 页面骨架，但不是 LxBox 全功能迁移。Android host 的 manifest 组件与实现不成闭环，核心 push streams 没有接到新 UI，Taildrop 发送/保存和 OpenConnect browser callback 仍显式失败，legacy backup/VPN settings/migration 仍需宿主或外部 metadata。不能以当前 PoC/骨架宣称完整迁移。

command_client: most CC calls are nested under core.call; this is not proof of legacy MethodChannel compatibility

evidence.detail: Legacy when(call.method) dispatch contains 127 branch rows (one duplicate ccTaildropDelete row); 126 unique names.
New public application boundary uses settings.get/config.get/config.save/vpn.* and core.call instead of the legacy 126-method channel.
Only a subset of CC names is dispatched by the new Controller; exact-name presence does not establish equivalent lifecycle, callback, or error semantics.

blockers: No generated compatibility matrix or adapter for all 126 legacy methods was found.
Some legacy methods are Android-only and require missing host components, not just Go dispatch aliases.

legacy_streams.new_stream_path: Go eventLog -> events.poll; selected async core handlers -> platform events.emit -> Android broadcast

coverage.detail: runtime has events.poll and service status events, but no direct equivalent to the legacy Android status EventChannel.
Controller.WriteDebugMessage emits through platform events, but new UI only polls runtime eventLog; no native-to-UI log sink is wired.
new noopCommandHandler.WriteStatus is empty; no status subscription or UI fan-out.
new noopCommandHandler.WriteOutbounds is empty; UI performs unary get only.
new noopCommandHandler.WriteGroups is empty; no push/refcount stream.
new noopCommandHandler.WriteConnectionEvents is empty and connectionsSnapshot explicitly returns an error.
unary status and ping session exist; no equivalent persistent native/Dart stream to the UI.
session emits platform events with client_id, but no new UI subscription consumes those broadcasts.
stage/result handlers exist, but only platform event emission is present.
status subscription handler exists, but event delivery is not attached to the new UI eventLog.
inbox subscription handler exists, but its events are platform broadcasts rather than a new UI stream.

evidence.detail: Legacy status/core/CC EventChannel contract lists 12 channels.
noopCommandHandler implements WriteStatus/WriteGroups/WriteOutbounds/WriteConnectionEvents/WriteDNSQuery as no-ops.
Async results call c.emitClient -> platform events.emit, not runtime.eventLog or a UI subscription.
New UI polls only events.poll every 1.5 seconds.

blockers: No replacement for legacy stream backpressure, delta accumulation, screen/profiler refcounts, pause/resume, or cold-start resync was found.

legacy_screen_workflows.coverage_observation: New UI has high-level Home/Servers/Config/Routing/DNS/Diagnostics/Tailscale/Taildrop/OpenConnect/WARP/Settings/Automation/Workspace/Backup/Advanced pages plus JSON editors. This is not equivalent to 193 old workflow files.
known_workflow_gaps: No reachable Add server wizard: serverWizard exists in import.go but no navigation call was found; Servers uses sourceEditor only.
No old-style node settings, chain editing flow, auto-group editing flow, DNS server catalog/editor, per-app trace, crash/OOM report workflows, or detailed backup category/restore preview flows found.
No live stats/profiler UI equivalent: Statistics shows status/outbounds actions and event text rather than old structured profiler/connection/DNS views.

evidence.detail: Static inventory found 193 Dart files under screens/.
New navigation has 18 high-level destinations.
serverWizard is implemented, but no call from the navigation/source page was found in the current tree.
Statistics is an event panel plus unary status/outbounds controls, not the legacy profiler workflow.

blockers: No screen/workflow mapping or golden workflow acceptance list was found; generic JSON editing cannot be counted as parity for structured screens.

feature_domains.scope: Builder/Parser/contract registry, strict validation and rejection behavior

evidence.detail: Parser supports JSON/YAML/URI lines/base64/WireGuard INI and loads protocol registry assets.
Builder expands wizard template, emits sources/directions/rules/DNS/route and can optionally call core option validation.
Runtime calls builder.Build without setting ValidateCore; saveConfig later calls libbox.CheckConfig.
Builder explicitly fatals on unsupported member metadata/flags and unsupported auto strategy fields instead of preserving all legacy semantics.

blockers: Only a small parser fixture set was found (ss, Clash YAML, WireGuard); no complete old golden corpus was found in the new app.
No formatConfig equivalent was found; only CheckConfig/validate is wired.
No CoreRejectGuard-style node disable/rebuild/retry flow is present in new runtime dispatch.

feature_domains.scope: lxbox_settings.json, workspaces, caches, legacy migration, backup and native VPN settings

evidence.detail: Bootstrap maps applicationInfo.dataDir/app_flutter to the legacy documents directory.
Workspace save/load/delete/rename, pending journal and sub_cache/rule_sets copy are implemented.
Backup envelope export/import exists.
Backup import explicitly warns category-level Dart merge and typed VPN preference application are not implemented in this Go layer.
Legacy migration requires external NodeLinks/PresetIDsByDNSTag/SubscriptionBodies; missing semantic facts force read-only.
Startup load calls MigrateDocumentWithOptions with empty options, so unresolved legacy links/preset mappings remain read-only.

blockers: Runtime never supplies MigrationOptions from parser/cache/template metadata.
vpn_settings are returned in BackupReport but not applied by Host/native preference bridge.
The full old Dart backup category merge/preview/restore contract is not reproduced.

feature_domains.scope: TUN, protect, routes, interfaces, Wi-Fi, notifications, service start/reload/stop

evidence.detail: Host implements vpn.openTun, protect, interfaces, connection owner, Wi-Fi, network monitor, DNS cache deletion and notification callbacks.
Host dispatches vpn.start/reload/stop by starting BoxVpnService.
Network monitor poll reads activeNetwork but does not show the research-report VPN exclusion/debounce implementation.
Manifest references LxBoxApplication, MainActivity, BoxVpnService, LxBoxTileService, BootReceiver, ExternalCommandReceiver and LxBoxAppFunctionService.

blockers: Current active Android source contains only Host.kt; no definitions for the manifest-referenced Application/Activity/VpnService/Tile/Boot/ExternalCommand/AppFunction classes were found.
Host references BoxVpnService.ACTION_RELOAD/live/replaceTun and MainActivity.current/requestSaf/requestPermission; these are unresolved in the current source tree.
This is a current-tree compile/runtime blocker, but parallel writes may still add the missing host files; recheck before final release judgment.

feature_domains.scope: Tailscale endpoint status/login/logout/exit node/ping and state persistence

evidence.detail: Unary Tailscale status/login/logout/exit-node methods and ping session dispatch exist.
Tailscale ping session handler emits client-scoped platform events.
UI exposes endpoint tag, status, login/logout, exit node and ping controls.

blockers: No equivalent persistent Tailscale state-directory identity store was found in new app runtime; builder/state directory behavior remains to be verified against old state-store contract.
No UI consumer for async ping/status event broadcasts was found.

feature_domains.scope: Taildrop inbox, download/save, delete, cancel, mark-read, send bytes/file, service files

evidence.detail: Inbox snapshot subscription, delete, cancel receiving and mark read are dispatched.
ccTaildropSendBytes explicitly returns an error requiring streaming chunks.
ccTaildropPickAndSend explicitly returns an error requiring Android host picker and URI handoff.
UI exposes Save, but calls ccTaildropSave, which has no Controller dispatch case in the current source.

blockers: No Taildrop chunk writer/session, native temporary download, SAF save/delete-after-save, offline inbox migration, automatic notification or service_files behavior was found.
New Taildrop UI buttons currently reach explicit errors or unknown core methods.

evidence.detail: OpenConnect status subscription and form submission handler exist.

Challenge field options and browser callback result delivery are not fully represented by the new async handler/UI model.
